diver: Neve: The water in here flows uphill. Don't ask me how.
diver_intro: Neve: You made it past the guard? Then let's battle!
mystic: Ilka: Maelis speaks with the Rift itself.
mystic_intro: Ilka: The currents told me you'd come.

lines: Maelis: The tide is still. Thank you, Tamer.
Your storage box now opens from the menu, wherever you are.

maelis_intro: Warden Maelis: Two Rifts in one season? Brave.
The tide tests everyone the same way. Begin!
maelis_defeat: Warden Maelis: You flow with your team, not against it.
From now on you can open your storage box from the menu.
Rest well. Veydal has more Rifts waiting... another day.
